events.title: Airplane and helicopter collision in Washington, D.C.
events.summary: An American Airlines jet and a U.S. Army helicopter collided in the airspace over Washington, D.C., resulting in both aircraft crashing into the Potomac River. Authorities reported that there were no survivors among the 67 individuals on board. This incident marks the most serious air disaster involving a commercial jet since 2009.
events.why_relevant: The crash raises significant concerns about aviation safety and government oversight, particularly in the context of recent staffing and leadership changes in federal aviation agencies.
events.basis: Authorities say there were no survivors.
